events.title: 19 peptides moved to Category 2
events.impact: FDA placed 19 peptides on Category 2 of the 503A Bulks List, signaling enforcement risk for compounding pharmacies.

events.title: HHS Secretary Kennedy signals intent to reclassify peptides
events.impact: Public statement (The Joe Rogan Experience) signaling HHS intent to revisit Category 2 placements.

events.title: PCAC July 23-24, 2026 meeting notice published
events.impact: FDA published the public notice and agenda for the July PCAC meeting to review 7 peptides removed from Category 2.

events.title: 12 peptides removed from Category 2
events.impact: Federal Register Doc. 2026-07361 (Docket FDA-2025-N-6895) removed 12 peptides from Category 2 pending PCAC review.

events.title: GHK-Cu (non-injectable) re-added to Category 1
events.impact: Topical/non-injectable copper tripeptide-1 re-added to the 503A Bulks List Category 1 — legal for compounding.

events.title: Deadline to register for PCAC oral testimony
events.impact: Last day for medspa advocates and clinicians to register to provide oral testimony at the July PCAC meeting.

events.title: Written comment deadline
events.impact: Last day to submit written comments to the docket that PCAC members will see before the meeting.

events.title: Public docket closes
events.impact: Hard cutoff (11:59 PM ET) for any docket submissions related to FDA-2025-N-6895.

events.title: PCAC Day 1 review (BPC-157, TB-500, KPV, MOTS-c)
events.impact: First day of PCAC peptide review. Vote outcomes inform whether peptides return to Category 1, remain off the list, or move back to Category 2.

events.title: PCAC Day 2 review (Emideltide, Semax, Epitalon)
events.impact: Second day of PCAC peptide review. Same vote outcomes apply.

events.title: Second PCAC wave
events.impact: Second wave review for GHK-Cu (injectable), LL-37, Dihexa, PEG-MGF, Melanotan II. Exact date TBD.

events.title: Final FDA rulemaking (estimated)
events.impact: FDA rulemaking to formally place reviewed peptides on or off the 503A Bulks List. Typically 1+ years after PCAC vote.
